title: chore: add patch changeset for v3.1.1
body:
Adds a changeset to trigger a patch release covering the improvements merged in #1007.

- **Changeset**: `.changeset/patch-release.md` — `"object-ui": patch`
- All 37+ packages bump together via the fixed versioning group in `.changeset/config.json`

Covers: semantic status color auto-detection, collapsible RelatedList, responsive table headers, row hover effect, record count Badge.
